 Show Most recent Most popular 'I've made peace with my last adventure' - Amorim's England return published at 19:43 BST 19:43 BST 
 Bournemouth v AC Milan (20:00 BST) 
 Image source, Getty Images This game sees Ruben Amorim return to England for the first time since his sacking by Manchester United last reason.
 The Portuguese manager was appointed by AC Milan in the summer and has guided them to an unbeaten Serie A start, that has them fourth. They lost their opening Europa League but won at Red Bull Salzburg last week. 
 He's even used a back four at times! 
 "It is different time - there are different situations in life. I am better now," Amorim told TNT Sports. 
 "I've made my peace with the last adventure and I'm really excited for the new one. I am really grateful for everything that happened - it brought me here."

 Excitement is building at the Vitality Stadium published at 19:24 BST 19:24 BST 
 Bournemouth v AC Milan (20:00) 
 Nizaar Kinsella 
BBC Sport senior football reporter at the Vitality Stadium 
 Bournemouth supporters and staff have been telling me on the way in that this could be the biggest occasion the club have hosted in their history.
 Demand from the media for this fixture is believed to be the highest the Vitality Stadium has ever seen, while leading figures from across the city and the football world are expected to be in attendance.
 Staff have been rushed off their feet throughout the day, but there is also a sense of excitement around an occasion many here will savour.
 Some hardcore supporters have told me that this is the most prestigious, rather than biggest fixture they have ever hosted, as they say some games in the EFL pyramid have had a bigger impact on the club's history.
